## Overview

This repository contains an Attempt to reproduction of the AR labeling experiments from the IEEE VIS 2023 publication. The project focuses on training reinforcement learning agents for optimal label placement in augmented reality environments and  different view management strategies.

---

### Model Training
- **Infrastructure**: Chameleon Cloud GPU (NVIDIA RTX 6000) at CHI@UC
- **Platform**: https://chameleoncloud.org/
- **Training Duration**: ~4 hours per scene
- **Training Steps**: ~20M steps
- **Scenes**: 
  - STU (Student) scene
  - NBA (Basketball) scene

### Value Heatmap Analysis
- Python-based computation of learned value heatmaps
- Visualizes the model's decision-making process

### View Management Evaluation
- Performance 3 view management methods: OURS, FORCE, NO
- Data exported from Unity 2022.3f environment as JSON
- Objective metrics comparison across methods

---
